name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=animate, descriptor=money_increment); name accurately reflects purpose (animated increment of the party gold counter with slot-machine roll). Consistent with sibling fd2_animate_money_decrement @ 0x2D516. No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Animated increment of the party gold counter: applies delta to the gold total immediately, then rolls each affected 8-digit decimal slot forward to its new value with a slot-machine sprite animation.
logic_summary: Snapshots the 8 current decimal digits via sprintf("%0.8d", gold) minus 0x30, adds delta to data_fd2_shared_party_total_gold, snapshots the 8 target digits the same way. Then an outer do-while diffs the two arrays: each position that differs is flagged (anim_state=1, all_match=0). While not all matched, an inner 9-frame loop, for each of 8 digit slots with anim_state!=0, blits sprite (cur_digit*9 + anim_state) at screen offset 0xA7A90 + pos*6 with width 0x140, increments anim_state, and on anim_state hitting 10 advances cur_digit by one (wrapping 10->0); each frame calls fd2_delay_ms(10). Carries to higher digit positions are resolved on the next outer re-diff. Loops until current digits equal target digits.

params.name: delta
params.semantics: Amount of gold to add to data_fd2_shared_party_total_gold; drives how many digit-roll steps the animation performs.
params.reason: Descriptive and accurate (the increment amount); no address residue, not the generic param_1.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effect is the updated gold total and the on-screen rolling animation.

writes_globals: data_fd2_shared_party_total_gold @ 0x53BF3 (incremented by delta at the start)
notes: Source comment block (aniui.c lines 125-151) is already precise, ASCII-only, and accurate against the decompilation and ground truth: data_fd2_shared_party_total_gold confirmed @ 0x53BF3 (list_globals), slot offset 0xA7A90 + pos*6, 9 rolling frames per advance, 10ms/frame cadence, carry resolution via next outer re-diff. Ghidra plate conveys the same algorithm and globals and is consistent with src, so no plate change.
